# has musical time frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasMusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-hasMusicalTimeFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMusicalTimeFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Relates a [`MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) to the [`MusicalTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md) in which its start and duration are expressed. Non-functional globally so that coexisting frames may be asserted; each [`MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) is constrained to exactly one frame by SHACL ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) -> [`gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasMusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-hasMusicalTimeFrame.md) from [`gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) to [`gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
